notes: Actual root cause of the empty Assignment tab found and fixed. fetchBundles / fetchAssignmentsForBundle were using relative URLs that worked client-side via the portal proxy but failed silently server-side from page.tsx. Sync was writing bundles fine the whole time; the portal just couldn't read them during SSR. After this release the diagnostic chip should turn green and the Assignment tab should finally show Assign dropdowns
Refactored: centralised URL resolution for local-* fetches into a shared helper so any future endpoint follows the same client-vs-server pattern automatically
